name: Penne Pasta with Tuna & Tomato Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain.
instructions.secondary_message:
salt
12 oz (4 ½ cups) penne pasta

instructions.primary_message: Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add onion and, stirring frequently, cook until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add garlic and pepper; cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add tomatoes, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until sauce begins to thicken, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (411 g) cans diced tomatoes
½ tsp Italian seasoning
salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain tuna and stir into the sauce. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 (120 g) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: Add pasta and toss to coat.
To serve, place pasta in a bowl. Enjoy!
